purpose: Maya-side source of truth for the four Film 304 cast rigs. Read by Tools/export_cast_from_maya.py, one character per mayapy process, because maya.standalone is single-scene.

export_rules.read_only: the source .ma/.mb is opened and never saved
export_rules.select: visible, non-intermediate, non-helper meshes that carry a skinCluster, plus the joint hierarchy above every influence
export_rules.exclude: rig control/helper geometry, intermediate originals, LOWRES proxies, constraints, cameras, lights
export_rules.animation: baked across the scene playback range so the clip survives the roundtrip
export_rules.textures: never embedded; the film textures are imported separately as UE assets
export_rules.refuse_existing: an existing export file is preserved; a revision must pick a new output name

helper_patterns: case-insensitive regex on the short transform name; matched meshes are excluded from export

Dana.note: Dana already passed the validated v08 roundtrip; this entry regenerates the same deform-only export for reproducibility

David.note: the project currently only has C_DavidRenderTest_OSC, an 11-slot test mesh with source PBR materials; this export is the production-grade replacement. The body needed an explicit visibility exception: David_Body_GEO is skinned (skinCluster105, 18432 tris) but the artist left visibility=false in the saved scene. The sibling David_Body_GEOBase / _GEOBase1 / David_PartialBody_GEO stay excluded because they carry no skinCluster.

Sam.note: Sam has no mesh anywhere in the project. Census 2026-10-16: 83 shapes, and the same body-hidden-by-the-artist situation as David - Sam_Body_GEO carries skinCluster152 and 18432 tris with visibility=false. Sam_Body_GEOBase, Sam_BodyFull_GEO and Sam_BodyPartial_GEO stay excluded because none of them carry a skinCluster. The face rig meshes (ChinRegion, LipRegion, JawOpenRegion, ...) are bound but are facial deformation helpers, excluded by helper_regex.

Spider.note: the SH110 creature. Probe-verified 2026-10-16: 11 visible bound meshes (body 9504 tris / 207 influences, 8 eyes, 2 fangs); 586 joints, 238 unique influences; LOWRES proxies correctly excluded. No texture maps shipped with the source, so body and eye are flat toon tints. v2 exists because v1 imported as only two slots named blinn2/blinn4 - the legacy importer used the Maya shading-group names, which merged body, eyes and fangs. material_roles gives the three parts distinct named slots.
